    toc: false

```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body { background: #070b18; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; color: #e6f1ff; }

  .dash-header {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0d1224 0%, #121829 100%);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1e2a45;
    padding: 18px 28px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
  }
  .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .logo-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00D4AA, #00a8ff); border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; }
  .logo-title { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; }
  .logo-sub { color: #8892b0; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 1.5px; }

  .tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
  .tab-btn {
    padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 8px; border: none;
    background: transparent; color: #8892b0; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; text-transform: capitalize;
  }
  .tab-btn.active { background: rgba(0,212,170,0.1); color: #00D4AA; border-bottom-color: #00D4AA; }

  .period-btns { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
  .period-btn {
    padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #2d3748;
    background: transparent; color: #8892b0; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .period-btn.active { border-color: #00D4AA; background: rgba(0,212,170,0.1); color: #00D4AA; }

  .main { padding: 28px; max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; }

  .kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .kpi-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1f35 0%, #0d1224 100%);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .kpi-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }
  .kpi-glow { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 0 16px 0 80px; }
  .kpi-icon { font-size: 26px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .kpi-label { color: #8892b0; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .kpi-value { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
  .kpi-change { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
  .kpi-sub { color: #8892b0; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 6px; font-weight: 400; }

  .charts-row { display: grid; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .charts-2-1 { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; }
  .charts-1-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

  .card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1f35 0%, #0d1224 100%);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #1e2a45;
  }
  .card-title { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .card-sub { color: #8892b0; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

  /* Category legend */
  .cat-legend { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .cat-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
  .cat-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .cat-name { font-size: 13px; color: #ccd6f6; margin-left: 8px; }

  /* Top Products */
  .product-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .product-rank { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: #1e2a45; border: 1px solid #2d3748; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #8892b0; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .product-rank.top { background: rgba(255,217,61,0.1); border-color: rgba(255,217,61,0.3); color: #FFD93D; }
  .product-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .product-bar-bg { height: 4px; background: #1e2a45; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
  .product-bar { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00D4AA, #00a8ff); border-radius: 2px; }
  .product-rev { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }
  .product-trend { color: #00D4AA; font-size: 11px; text-align: right; }

  /* Region bars */
  .region-row { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .region-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 7px; }
  .region-name { font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .region-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; }
  .region-val { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
  .region-pct { color: #8892b0; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 12px; }
  .region-bar-bg { height: 6px; background: #1e2a45; border-radius: 3px; }
  .region-bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; opacity: 0.85; }

  /* Table */
  .prod-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0 8px; }
  .prod-table th { color: #8892b0; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 400; }
  .prod-table td { padding: 15px 14px; background: #0d1224; transition: background 0.2s; font-size: 13px; }
  .prod-table tr:hover td { background: #1a1f35; }
  .prod-table td:first-child { border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px; }
  .prod-table td:last-child { border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; }
  .badge { background: rgba(0,212,170,0.12); color: #00D4AA; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

  .tab-panel { display: none; }
  .tab-panel.active { display: block; }

  .footer { margin-top: 28px; text-align: center; color: #4a5568; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; padding: 16px; }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .charts-2-1, .charts-1-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 500px) {
    .kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HEADER -->
<div class="dash-header">
  <div class="logo">
    <div class="logo-icon">⚡</div>
    <div>
      <div class="logo-title">ShopMetrics</div>
      <div class="logo-sub">E-COMMERCE ANALYTICS</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="switchTab('overview')">Overview</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('products')">Products</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('regions')">Regions</button>
  </div>
  <div class="period-btns">
    <button class="period-btn" onclick="setPeriod(3, this)">3M</button>
    <button class="period-btn" onclick="setPeriod(6, this)">6M</button>
    <button class="period-btn active" onclick="setPeriod(12, this)">12M</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- MAIN -->
<div class="main">

  <!-- KPI Cards -->
  <div class="kpi-grid">
    <div class="kpi-card" style="border:1px solid rgba(0,212,170,0.15); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,212,170,0.1)">
      <div class="kpi-glow" style="background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,212,170,0.15) 0%,transparent 70%)"></div>
      <div class="kpi-icon">💰</div>
      <div class="kpi-label">Total Revenue</div>
      <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-rev">$814K</div>
      <div class="kpi-change" style="color:#00D4AA">▲ 23.4% <span class="kpi-sub">vs last year</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card" style="border:1px solid rgba(0,168,255,0.15); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,168,255,0.1)">
      <div class="kpi-glow" style="background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,168,255,0.15) 0%,transparent 70%)"></div>
      <div class="kpi-icon">📦</div>
      <div class="kpi-label">Total Orders</div>
      <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-orders">6,323</div>
      <div class="kpi-change" style="color:#00a8ff">▲ 18.7% <span class="kpi-sub">vs last year</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card" style="border:1px solid rgba(255,217,61,0.15); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(255,217,61,0.1)">
      <div class="kpi-glow" style="background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,217,61,0.15) 0%,transparent 70%)"></div>
      <div class="kpi-icon">🎯</div>
      <div class="kpi-label">Avg Order Value</div>
      <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-aov">$129</div>
      <div class="kpi-change" style="color:#FFD93D">▲ 4.2% <span class="kpi-sub">vs last year</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card" style="border:1px solid rgba(199,125,255,0.15); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(199,125,255,0.1)">
      <div class="kpi-glow" style="background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(199,125,255,0.15) 0%,transparent 70%)"></div>
      <div class="kpi-icon">📊</div>
      <div class="kpi-label">Conversion Rate</div>
      <div class="kpi-value">8.6%</div>
      <div class="kpi-change" style="color:#FF6B6B">▼ 1.3% <span class="kpi-sub">vs last year</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- OVERVIEW TAB -->
  <div id="tab-overview" class="tab-panel active">
    <div class="charts-row charts-2-1">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Revenue Trend</div>
        <div class="card-sub">Monthly revenue & order volume</div>
        <canvas id="revenueChart" height="220"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Sales by Category</div>
        <div class="card-sub">Revenue share breakdown</div>
        <canvas id="categoryChart" height="180"></canvas>
        <div class="cat-legend" id="catLegend"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="charts-row charts-1-1">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Weekly Traffic</div>
        <div class="card-sub">Visitors vs Conversions</div>
        <canvas id="trafficChart" height="200"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Top Products</div>
        <div class="card-sub">By total revenue generated</div>
        <div id="topProducts"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PRODUCTS TAB -->
  <div id="tab-products" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Product Performance</div>
      <div class="card-sub">Detailed product-level analytics</div>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto">
        <table class="prod-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Rank</th><th>Product</th><th>Units Sold</th><th>Revenue</th><th>Growth</th><th>Performance</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="productTableBody"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- REGIONS TAB -->
  <div id="tab-regions" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="charts-row charts-1-1">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Sales by Region</div>
        <div class="card-sub">Regional revenue distribution</div>
        <canvas id="regionChart" height="260"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Region Breakdown</div>
        <div class="card-sub">Performance metrics per region</div>
        <div id="regionBars"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer">SHOPMETRICS DASHBOARD · DATA UPDATED 2024 · BUILT BY PREETHI GANTA</div>
</div>

<script>
// ── DATA ──────────────────────────────────────────────
const allMonths = [
  { month:"Jan", revenue:42000, orders:320 },
  { month:"Feb", revenue:38500, orders:290 },
  { month:"Mar", revenue:51000, orders:410 },
  { month:"Apr", revenue:47800, orders:375 },
  { month:"May", revenue:63200, orders:490 },
  { month:"Jun", revenue:58900, orders:455 },
  { month:"Jul", revenue:71400, orders:540 },
  { month:"Aug", revenue:66700, orders:515 },
  { month:"Sep", revenue:79300, orders:610 },
  { month:"Oct", revenue:84500, orders:650 },
  { month:"Nov", revenue:98700, orders:780 },
  { month:"Dec", revenue:112000, orders:890 },
];
const categories = [
  { name:"Electronics", value:38, color:"#00D4AA" },
  { name:"Fashion",     value:27, color:"#FF6B6B" },
  { name:"Home & Living",value:18,color:"#FFD93D" },
  { name:"Beauty",      value:11, color:"#C77DFF" },
  { name:"Sports",      value:6,  color:"#4ECDC4" },
];
const topProducts = [
  { name:"iPhone 15 Pro",  sales:1240, revenue:148800, trend:"+12%" },
  { name:"Samsung 4K TV",  sales:760,  revenue:152000, trend:"+21%" },
  { name:"Dyson Airwrap",  sales:690,  revenue:103500, trend:"+5%"  },
  { name:"Nike Air Max",   sales:980,  revenue:88200,  trend:"+8%"  },
  { name:"Yoga Mat Pro",   sales:620,  revenue:37200,  trend:"+18%" },
];
const regions = [
  { region:"East",    sales:31200, color:"#FFD93D" },
  { region:"North",   sales:28400, color:"#00D4AA" },
  { region:"South",   sales:21700, color:"#FF6B6B" },
  { region:"West",    sales:19800, color:"#C77DFF" },
  { region:"Central", sales:14300, color:"#4ECDC4" },
];
const traffic = [
  { day:"Mon", visitors:4200, conversions:310 },
  { day:"Tue", visitors:3800, conversions:280 },
  { day:"Wed", visitors:5100, conversions:420 },
  { day:"Thu", visitors:4700, conversions:390 },
  { day:"Fri", visitors:6300, conversions:540 },
  { day:"Sat", visitors:7800, conversions:680 },
  { day:"Sun", visitors:5900, conversions:490 },
];

// ── CHART DEFAULTS ────────────────────────────────────
Chart.defaults.color = "#8892b0";
Chart.defaults.borderColor = "#1e2a45";
Chart.defaults.font.family = "'DM Sans', sans-serif";

let revenueChart, categoryChart, trafficChart, regionChart;
let currentPeriod = 12;

// ── REVENUE CHART ─────────────────────────────────────
function buildRevenueChart(months) {
  const ctx = document.getElementById("revenueChart").getContext("2d");
  const grad1 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,300);
  grad1.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,212,170,0.35)");
  grad1.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,212,170,0)");
  const grad2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,300);
  grad2.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,168,255,0.25)");
  grad2.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,168,255,0)");

  if (revenueChart) revenueChart.destroy();
  revenueChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type:"line",
    data:{
      labels: months.map(m=>m.month),
      datasets:[
        { label:"Revenue ($)", data:months.map(m=>m.revenue), borderColor:"#00D4AA", backgroundColor:grad1, borderWidth:2.5, pointRadius:3, pointBackgroundColor:"#00D4AA", fill:true, tension:0.4 },
        { label:"Orders",      data:months.map(m=>m.orders),  borderColor:"#00a8ff", backgroundColor:grad2, borderWidth:2,   pointRadius:3, pointBackgroundColor:"#00a8ff", fill:true, tension:0.4 },
      ]
    },
    options:{ responsive:true, plugins:{ legend:{ labels:{ color:"#8892b0", font:{size:12} } } }, scales:{ x:{ grid:{color:"#1e2a45"} }, y:{ grid:{color:"#1e2a45"} } } }
  });
}

// ── CATEGORY PIE ──────────────────────────────────────
function buildCategoryChart() {
  const ctx = document.getElementById("categoryChart").getContext("2d");
  if (categoryChart) categoryChart.destroy();
  categoryChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type:"doughnut",
    data:{
      labels: categories.map(c=>c.name),
      datasets:[{ data:categories.map(c=>c.value), backgroundColor:categories.map(c=>c.color), borderWidth:3, borderColor:"#0d1224", hoverOffset:6 }]
    },
    options:{ cutout:"65%", responsive:true, plugins:{ legend:{display:false}, tooltip:{ callbacks:{ label: ctx=> ` ${ctx.label}: ${ctx.raw}%` } } } }
  });
  // Legend
  const leg = document.getElementById("catLegend");
  leg.innerHTML = categories.map(c=>`
    <div class="cat-row">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center">
        <div class="cat-dot" style="background:${c.color}"></div>
        <span class="cat-name">${c.name}</span>
      </div>
      <span style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:${c.color};font-weight:600">${c.value}%</span>
    </div>`).join("");
}

// ── TRAFFIC CHART ─────────────────────────────────────
function buildTrafficChart() {
  const ctx = document.getElementById("trafficChart").getContext("2d");
  if (trafficChart) trafficChart.destroy();
  trafficChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type:"bar",
    data:{
      labels: traffic.map(d=>d.day),
      datasets:[
        { label:"Visitors",    data:traffic.map(d=>d.visitors),    backgroundColor:"rgba(0,168,255,0.75)", borderRadius:4 },
        { label:"Conversions", data:traffic.map(d=>d.conversions), backgroundColor:"rgba(0,212,170,0.85)", borderRadius:4 },
      ]
    },
    options:{ responsive:true, plugins:{ legend:{ labels:{ color:"#8892b0" } } }, scales:{ x:{ grid:{display:false} }, y:{ grid:{color:"#1e2a45"} } } }
  });
}

// ── TOP PRODUCTS ──────────────────────────────────────
function buildTopProducts() {
  const container = document.getElementById("topProducts");
  const maxRev = Math.max(...topProducts.map(p=>p.revenue));
  container.innerHTML = topProducts.map((p,i)=>`
    <div class="product-row">
      <div class="product-rank ${i===0?'top':''}">${String(i+1).padStart(2,"0")}</div>
      <div style="flex:1">
        <div class="product-name">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="product-bar-bg">
          <div class="product-bar" style="width:${(p.revenue/maxRev*100).toFixed(0)}%"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="product-rev">$${(p.revenue/1000).toFixed(0)}K</div>
        <div class="product-trend">${p.trend}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join("");
}

// ── REGION CHART ──────────────────────────────────────
function buildRegionChart() {
  const ctx = document.getElementById("regionChart").getContext("2d");
  if (regionChart) regionChart.destroy();
  regionChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type:"bar",
    data:{
      labels: regions.map(r=>r.region),
      datasets:[{ label:"Sales ($)", data:regions.map(r=>r.sales), backgroundColor:regions.map(r=>r.color), borderRadius:6 }]
    },
    options:{
      indexAxis:"y", responsive:true,
      plugins:{ legend:{display:false} },
      scales:{ x:{ grid:{color:"#1e2a45"} }, y:{ grid:{display:false} } }
    }
  });
}

// ── REGION BARS ───────────────────────────────────────
function buildRegionBars() {
  const total = regions.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.sales,0);
  document.getElementById("regionBars").innerHTML = regions.map(r=>{
    const pct = ((r.sales/total)*100).toFixed(1);
    return `
      <div class="region-row">
        <div class="region-header">
          <div class="region-name">
            <div class="region-dot" style="background:${r.color}"></div>${r.region}
          </div>
          <div>
            <span class="region-val" style="color:${r.color}">$${(r.sales/1000).toFixed(1)}K</span>
            <span class="region-pct">${pct}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="region-bar-bg">
          <div class="region-bar" style="width:${pct}%;background:${r.color}"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

// ── PRODUCT TABLE ─────────────────────────────────────
function buildProductTable() {
  document.getElementById("productTableBody").innerHTML = topProducts.map((p,i)=>`
    <tr>
      <td style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;color:${i===0?'#FFD93D':'#8892b0'}">#${i+1}</td>
      <td style="font-weight:500">${p.name}</td>
      <td style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;color:#ccd6f6">${p.sales.toLocaleString()}</td>
      <td style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;color:#00D4AA;font-weight:600">$${p.revenue.toLocaleString()}</td>
      <td><span class="badge">${p.trend}</span></td>
      <td><div style="height:6px;background:#1e2a45;border-radius:3px;width:120px">
        <div style="width:${(p.revenue/160000*100).toFixed(0)}%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00D4AA,#00a8ff);border-radius:3px"></div>
      </div></td>
    </tr>`).join("");
}

// ── KPI UPDATE ────────────────────────────────────────
function updateKPIs(months) {
  const rev = months.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.revenue,0);
  const ord = months.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.orders,0);
  document.getElementById("kpi-rev").textContent    = "$"+Math.round(rev/1000)+"K";
  document.getElementById("kpi-orders").textContent = ord.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById("kpi-aov").textContent    = "$"+Math.round(rev/ord);
}

// ── TAB SWITCH ────────────────────────────────────────
function switchTab(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
  document.getElementById("tab-"+name).classList.add("active");
  event.target.classList.add("active");
  if (name==="regions") { buildRegionChart(); buildRegionBars(); }
}

// ── PERIOD ────────────────────────────────────────────
function setPeriod(n, btn) {
  currentPeriod = n;
```
